neighbours.label: the piece ' de' as its own token at the start of a word or Latin phrase ('de|acon', 'de facto', 'de novo')
fire: After years of study she was made a deacon in the diocese.
The elders and deacons gathered before the morning service.
In our village, the old deaconess looked after the sick.
The committee has become the de facto government of the province.
Her cousin now acts as the de facto manager of the family farm.
The law was struck down, but de facto segregation remained for years.
On appeal, the court reviewed the question de novo last spring.
Segregation had been in force, both de jure and in daily practice.
quiet: After years of study she was made a bishop in the diocese.
The elders and ushers gathered before the morning service.
In our village, the old midwife looked after the sick.
The committee has become the interim government of the province.
Her cousin now acts as the temporary manager of the family farm.
The law was struck down, but informal segregation remained for years.
On appeal, the court reviewed the question again last spring.
Segregation had been in force, both in law and in daily practice.

notes: Whole-token words such as ' dean' and ' decades' stayed quiet in probing, so this is about the piece, not about church offices. The 'trigger' is declared so that coverage is measured.
